page.layout: One printed page, text only. Running head with page number at the top. Running text in one column, then a centred heading (EXERC. V.), a two-line italic heading, and a paragraph with a marginal note at the right, beside its first line. Catchword at the right below the last line, gathering signature at the left below it. The right side of the scan is blank.

main_text.p: perfectissima attingat opera, & absoluat. Sic igitur ad nostrorum corporum generationem natura primum herbas, fructus & plantarum semina ex elementis gignit: quibus postea uescuntur animalia, quæ fructibus & herbis nutriuntur, & augentur. Ex illis tandem cibum capimus: dein e cibo sanguis, pituita & utraque bilis in nobis gignuntur, quæ nostræ generationis proxima iam sunt materia. Ex his quoque humoribus nutrimur & augemur, quandiu nostra patitur natura, & hic uiuimus. Ipsa igitur quatuor elementa nostrum corpus componit, non quod inter se transmutentur, & alia ex aliis fiant, sed quod permisceantur, & ex eorum permistione materia fiat ad misti formam recipienda apta.
main_text.head: EXERC. V.

head.i: VTRVM IN MISTORVM GENE-ratione permisceantur solæ elementorum qualitates ?

main_text.p: Fernelius libro de Elementis secundo, quatuor primas elementorum qualitates (quæ sunt calor, frigiditas, siccitas & humiditas) in mistorum generatione per se misceri, concludit. Verum quam fit hoc ab-Cap.8.

page.notes: Text on the right of the scan is blank, so the printed page is only the left one. The catchword "surdum" is partly unclear (first letter read as long s); the full word is probably "absurdum". "miscerí" was read as "misceri" with the long s and accent unclear. "ficcitas" is printed that way and was copied as seen. The drop cap F of "Fernelius" was read as F. The marginal note "Cap.8." is in italic. The heading "EXERC. V." is set off by spacing and was taken as level 1 with caput 5.
